attributes.name: Nunchaku +1
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Acrobatics, Strength, or Melee skill + 1d6+1; you may additionally recharge this card to add another 1d6. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.

On your combat check, if proficient with weapons, and you played a weapon and it does not have the 2-Handed trait, you may discard this card to add 1d4 and the Bludgeoning trait.
